facts.fact: The NIDA Director General said NIDA plans to connect the national ID with services including the birth certificate, from four services now to nine.

TZA.note: The document gives no count or share of people enrolled.
The document does not mention a number at birth.
The document does not say who operates or maintains the system.

facts.fact: The NIDA Director General listed the taxpayer identification number (TIN) among the services NIDA plans to connect to the national ID.
The NIDA Director General said the current ID has four parts and will be upgraded to nine under the name Jamii Namba, with four services available now.
